verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
No other god can be called a Father
No other god can be called a Friend
No other god can be called Redeemer
No other god’s coming back again

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
How we love Your name, Jesus
You’re the Beautiful One
We love Your name

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
How we love You, King of kings
How we love You, Lord of lords

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
We love the fragrance of Your holy name
You came and brought us into the reign of grace

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Glory to the Righteous One
Glory to the Righteous One

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Worthy is the Lamb
That was slain

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
Worthy of glory
Worthy of honor
Worthy of power
Worthy of praise
